notes: The two supplied copulas (t020, t028) go to the prepositional predicates נֹכַח לְ and מִן under rule 49 rather than to the following nouns.
Both articles on toponyms behave differently by what the ASV writes: s015 before Gilgal is unrepresented because no the is written, while s026 in לַנָּחַל takes the the standing before its own word.
s010 fuses and so into the waw; the competing reading gives the waw only and and marks so added under rule 30, and the unit note records why the fused reading was taken.
